column1: # Names for the game's map icon kinds (stage 8, "go to nearest", 2026-10-19). The game cache has each kind's picture and
# where it is shown (invisible marker objects carrying a map icon id; cache 2735: 369 kinds placed) but NO names, so the
# names here were written by Claude from each icon's picture and the named objects found beside its places
# (gradlew -p tool mapIconSurvey); NOT yet checked by the owner, who picks which kinds get a button.
# Only the kinds named here go into the plugin's places.tsv; a kind left out here is not offered.
# icon <tab> kind (as the sidebar shows it) <tab> why this name (beside = named objects within 5 tiles of its places;
# "Name not sure:" = named from the picture only, the card asks the owner to check). The owner keeps, removes or
# renames each kind on its card in the Data Tool (PLACE_KIND changes in changes.jsonl); this file is not changed by that.
